title: steps/memoryStore payload
description: Payload for the memoryStore hook. Fires before the agent writes to persistent memory.

memory_id.description: Identifier for the memory entry being written or updated

provenance.description: OPTIONAL in the base schema; REQUIRED under provenance_producer: deterministic (ACS-Provenance). Validate against memory-store.acs-provenance.json when the profile is claimed. See Specification section 7.
